topic: How can satellite link budgets be optimized for high throughput and low latency in global aeronautical coverage?
response: To optimize satellite link budgets for high throughput and low latency in global aeronautical coverage, consider the following: (1) Implement advanced modulation and coding schemes (e.g., 16APSK, 64QAM) to increase spectral efficiency. (2) Use adaptive coding and modulation (ACM) to adjust transmission parameters based on link conditions. (3) Implement frequency reuse and polarization techniques to increase capacity. (4) Employ advanced link budget analysis tools, such as the ITU-R Recommendation M.1225, to accurately predict link performance.
